summary: COZA fresh build tested end-to-end (backend + mobile web frontend). Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass (100%) against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — auth (signup/login/me + JWT), catalog list with pagination/filters/search/sort, product detail (200/404), filters bounds, analytics (donut + bar data), meta, and favorites full CRUD. Data is real (4451 seeded Zara Woman products, valid origins & supplier codes). Frontend (390x844 web viewport): login with seed user works, catalog grid renders real Zara images/prices with origin badges (e.g. FAS, TÜRKİYE) and supplier codes (e.g. MA-698, TR-506), search debouncing works, filter sheet opens, origin filter (Türkiye) returns filtered items with correct badges, product detail shows Üretim Yeri + Tedarikçi Kodu, analytics KPIs + donut + bar render, favorites tab loads, profile shows user, theme toggle switches dark↔light, logout button present. One UX bug found: FilterSheet (BottomSheetModal) does not auto-dismiss when the user navigates to another tab while it is open — it persists on top of Analytics/Favorites/Profile screens. Console warnings from @gorhom/bottom-sheet: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' and 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19' — library-level noise, not app bugs. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av etc.) detected. No red screens.

ui_bugs.issue: Bottom sheet does NOT dismiss when the user taps a tab-bar item (Analiz/Favoriler/Profil) while the sheet is open. It persists on top of the newly-navigated screen, blocking interaction. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (sheetRef is only dismissed in onApply). Add sheetRef.current?.dismiss() on useFocusEffect blur, or listen to tab navigation to auto-dismiss.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19'. These originate inside the bottom-sheet library. Consider upgrading @gorhom/bottom-sheet to the latest React 19 compatible release or accept as harmless noise on web preview.

action_items: Fix FilterSheet persistence: dismiss the BottomSheetModal on tab blur (e.g. via useFocusEffect cleanup or router event listener) so it does not overlay other tabs.
Optional: bump @gorhom/bottom-sheet to a React-19-clean version to silence pointerEvents / element.ref warnings.
Optional: consider caching /api/filters and /api/analytics on the client (short TTL) to avoid re-fetch on every focus event.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py explicitly excludes MongoDB _id in every projection ({'_id': 0}) — good.
Passwords are bcrypt-hashed and truncated to 72 bytes safely; JWT signed with env secret; auth guard returns 401 on invalid/missing tokens.
Favorites use compound unique index (user_id, product_id) with $setOnInsert — idempotent adds work as verified.
Backend uses async motor everywhere; APScheduler configured for Europe/Istanbul 08:00 daily scrape.
No file exceeds 700 lines; server.py ~380 lines, catalog screen ~330 lines.
All interactive elements expose testID (login/signup fields, open-filters, category-chip-*, search-input, theme-toggle, logout, refresh-data, product-grid).
Turkish copy consistent across screens; error messages in Turkish.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded catalog (4451 products) and existing test user tester@coza.app / Test1234. Created transient TEST_<uuid>@coza.app accounts for signup validation (auto-cleanable by prefix). No writes to production/seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://coza-tracker.preview.emergentagent.com. Test user tester@coza.app / Test1234 seeded. Catalog seed already present (~4451 products). Do NOT trigger /api/admin/scrape unnecessarily (external proxy, ~70s, limited credits). Filter sheet UX bug reproduces by opening filters on Catalog then tapping any other tab; expected fix location: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx.
rca_of_issue: FilterSheet persistence bug: sheetRef.current?.dismiss() is only called inside onApply. Expo Router does not automatically unmount tab screens (BottomSheetModal from @gorhom lives in a portal), so navigation events don't propagate dismiss. Fix: attach a router / tab-focus listener in Catalog that calls sheetRef.current?.dismiss() on blur, or hoist a global modal-dismisser.
